question: Narali Poornima marks the end of monsoon season in which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narali Poornima** is a festival celebrated in **Maharashtra**, which marks the **end of the monsoon season.**
 
• The festival is celebrated on the **full moon day **of the **Hindu month of Shravana.**
 
• The festival is also known as **Coconut Day,** as people offer coconuts to the **sea god Varuna** on this day.
 
• Maharashtra is a state located in the western region of India, and it experiences monsoon season from **June to September.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bihar** is a state located in the** eastern region **of India, and it also experiences monsoon season from** June to September.**

 
 
• Some festivals of Bihar include** Chatth Puja, Sama Chakeva, Shravani Mela, Sonepur Cattle Fair, and Makar Sankranti Mela.**
 
 
 
• **West Bengal **is also a state located in the eastern region of India, and it experiences monsoon season from **June to September.**
 
 
• Some festivals of West Bengal include** Durga Puja, Jamai Shashti, Charak Puja and Poush Sankranti.**
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu** is a state located in the southern region of India, and it experiences monsoon season from **October to December.**
 
 
• Some festivals of Tamil Nadu include **Pongal Festival, Natyanjali Dance Festival, Karthigai Deepam and Jallikattu Bull Festival.**
